{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Homeownership has not been in reach for all Americans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Decades of red-lining, rising income inequality, and predatory lending practices targeting low-income families and people of color have made homeownership all but impossible for millions of working families.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Homeownership is central to building generational wealth.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Expanding access to homeownership to those who have been unfairly excluded and discriminated against is critical to closing the racial wealth gap.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"There is a nationwide shortage of affordable housing units.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Tens of millions of Americans live in homes that pose risks to their health and safety.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Homelessness has reached crisis proportions in a growing number of states.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Housing costs that rise faster than wages have put the squeeze on renters in many of the biggest cities.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Housing in America should be stable, accessible, safe, healthy, energy efficient, and affordable.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"No one should have to spend more than 30 percent of their income on housing, so families have ample resources left to meet their other needs and save for retirement.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Families should have ample resources left to meet their other needs and save for retirement if they do not spend more than 30 percent of their income on housing.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
